item.title: Molru
item.description: Starting point Korean learning material divided only into grammar and vocabulary can make it difficult to encounter everyday life and culture in context. Molru starts with something worth reading, while keeping learning support nearby for the moments when it is needed. Content structure Content is organized into Daily Korean, K-Culture, Stories, and Korean Now. The topics cover everyday conversations, customs and culture, personal stories, and current expressions and trends so that language and context can be understood together.

item.title: SchemaPad
item.description: Problem and goal I wanted a lightweight way to sketch a database structure and move it into SQL without requiring an account, installation, or server-side document storage. SchemaPad connects early schema design and the visualization of existing SQL in one browser-based workspace. Core workflow Users can create tables and columns, connect relationships, and arrange an ERD visually. PostgreSQL and MySQL SQL can be imported to inspect an existing schema or exported after editing a design.

item.title: Slow Mind
item.description: Why I built it I wanted a small web tool that could be used immediately for a quiet pause or focused session, without an account or complicated setup. Rather than presenting a large library of meditation content, the product centers on choosing an environment and staying with it. User experience Users can choose Forest, Ocean, Space, Mountain, Rain, or Sky and play matching visuals and ambient sound. The controls are deliberately limited to play, pause, mute, and volume.

item.title: PhotoAI
item.description: Problem hypothesis People sometimes need a new application photo just before a deadline or interview, when a studio may be too expensive, distant, or slow. PhotoAI began with a simple question: could one front-facing photo reduce that time and cost? The intended result was not a novelty AI image, but a polished and recognizably personal portrait suitable for a job application. User context Job seekers facing an application or interview deadline People constrained by the time or distance required for a studio visit People who prefer a one-time purchase over a subscription The product therefore prioritized a short path from upload to style selection and result, rather than a large feature set.

item.title: Search Visibility Rank Checker
item.description: Overview The Search Visibility Rank Checker was built to reduce the repetitive work involved in confirming whether advertised products appear across different search environments. Given keywords and sellers, it checks up to 20 entries in a batch and summarizes their visibility and observed rank by channel. Configure keywords, sellers, and search environments, then review the results together Starting point A marketing practitioner was repeatedly searching the same terms across desktop, mobile, shopping, and general search surfaces, then recording the results separately.
